title: Governed Goal Frontier Capability-Local Business Ontology Candidate

records.meaning: The private Craft Product that embodies CAV2-D20 Craft Method.
The private Project coordinating Craft goals, owners, evidence, decisions, artifacts, work, and lifecycle.
The unregistered continuous Goal candidate for DomainSpec-governed construction and evidenced frontier closure.
The stable candidate outcome of preserving an exact dependency-aware Goal frontier and explicit owner gates across planning rounds.
Project owners and agents can continue work without losing dependency, evidence, owner, gate, or incompleteness state.
The owner who controls whether this outcome belongs to the Craft Product and whether its Product Capability is adopted.
The owner who controls the private Project, Goal coordination, and frontier suitability.
The agent that may inspect and propose against one exact private frontier without owning its meaning or effects.
One immutable bundle of exact Project, registered Goal, work graph, thesis and definition selectors, decisions, owner routes, gates, and claim ceilings.
A non-effectful observation and proposed next delta bound to one Authoritative Goal Bundle.
An exact owner accept, revise, reject, defer, or stop decision over one immutable proposal digest.
The replaceable public Goal spell used only for bounded advisory operations after private route admission.
Require exact carrier identities, digests, dependency edges, owner routes, CA2 routes, gates, D65 state, decisions, and claim ceiling.
Return a source-bound observation, proposed delta, dropped-field report, blockers, residue, and next human gate with authority effect none.
Private Project, Goal, work graph, owner decisions, and CA2 routes remain authoritative over any technique projection.
Public code and generated surfaces may compute advisory evidence but may not own Product meaning, route, state, approval, or promotion.
Only a separate owner decision over an immutable private proposal may make a later promotion eligible for its own route.
The exact-digest prebinding of permitted public Goal spell operations behind the private capability boundary.
Carrier closure, dependency readiness, field preservation, owner and gate continuity, D65 order, exact promotion, no public authority, determinism, and independent conformance.
The intended continuous Goal is not registered or bidirectionally referenced by the Craft Project.
Goals and Craft validation are blocked by source drift and successor-epoch contract work.
The public frontier schema drops dependency, risk, owner, route, gate, and D65 information required for private authority decisions.
DomainSpec source, compiled graph, system ontology, implementation binding, conformance, runtime evidence, and enforcement are not evaluable.

Whether coordinates, consumes, proposes, binds, decides, binds_as_replaceable_technique, and candidate_realization_of are admitted relation types for this ontology
Whether this exact outcome belongs to the Craft Product or requires a successor Product Capability under another Product
Which owner controls admission of the capability-local ontology and its relation vocabulary
ambient_ontology_drift_policy: Diagnostic unless it intersects the selected_dependencies above; missing, changed, or ambiguous selected bytes remain fail-closed.
claim_ceiling: Endpoint-closed planning candidate only; no canonical-definition promotion, Product Capability adoption, ontology admission, DomainSpec source, implementation binding, conformance, runtime authorization, publication, release, deployment, or external effect.
